A '''mattock''' is a hybrid [[Tools|tool]] that works as both a shovel and a hoe. It mines both kinds of blocks, but more slowly than a shovel or hoe of the same tier.

In the video, the developer introduces mattocks and dolabras as a fix for inventory clutter: "If you find yourself frustrated that your hot bar is always full of tools and don't mind mining a little slower, the delabre and madic are a good choice for you.{{Cite video|quote=If you find yourself frustrated that your hot bar is always full of tools and don't mind mining a little slower, the delabre and madic are a good choice for you.}}

== Obtaining ==
Copper, iron and diamond mattocks are crafted (two ingots on top, one on the right, and two sticks). Steel, shakudo, hepatizon, electrum and adamant mattocks are smithed from a copper, iron or diamond hoe or mattock with the alloy '''and''' a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]]; without the template the same recipe makes a plain hoe.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_mattock.json}}</ref> Mattocks use hoe item IDs.

== Usage ==
A mattock tills and mines everything in <code>#minecraft:mineable/shovel</code> and <code>#minecraft:mineable/hoe</code>. Since 1.10 newly made mattocks drop snowballs from snow.

== Advancements ==
* ''Two in One'': craft a mattock or dolabra.
* ''Three in One?'': upgrade a mattock or dolabra at a smithing table.
